title: Be interested in
subtitle: 感興趣，究竟是哪一種「有興趣」？
description: 感興趣，究竟是哪一種「有興趣」？

words.note: 很常見，特別是英式英語；表示對活動、科目或事物有明顯興趣。
words.example: She is keen on photography and takes her camera everywhere.
words.exampleZh: 她很喜歡攝影，去哪裡都帶著相機。

exercises.original: She is very interested in photography and takes her camera everywhere.
exercises.zh: 她很喜歡攝影，去哪裡都帶著相機。
exercises.upgrade: be keen on · 很喜歡；對……很有興趣

options.explanation: be good at = be good at = 擅長，不等於喜歡或有興趣。
know about = know about = 知道相關資料，不代表有興趣。
be keen on = 句子表示對某項活動或興趣有明顯喜愛，因此 be keen on 很自然。
be involved in = be involved in = 參與其中，可能只是工作需要。
understand = understand = 理解，不等於感興趣。
pay attention to = pay attention to = 留意，不一定因為喜歡。

falseSynonyms.zh: 知道不等於感興趣 know about 表示已經知道某事；be interested in 表示想關注或了解。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I know about the topic, but I am not especially interested in it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 喜歡不一定等於有興趣 like 表示喜歡；有興趣可以來自好奇，即使不一定喜歡。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She does not like spiders, but she is interested in studying them.

falseSynonyms.zh: 理解不等於有興趣 understand 表示明白；不代表想進一步了解。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He understands economics, but he is not particularly interested in it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 留意不等於感興趣 pay attention to 表示集中注意力；可以因責任而留意，未必因為有興趣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You must pay attention to the safety instructions even if you are not interested in them.

falseSynonyms.zh: 擅長不等於感興趣 be good at 表示能力強；一個人可以擅長某事但並不喜歡。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is good at mathematics but is more interested in art.

falseSynonyms.zh: 參與不等於有興趣 be involved in 表示參與某件事；參與可能出於工作或責任。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He is involved in the project, but he is not personally interested in the topic.

falseSynonyms.zh: 令人感興趣不等於感到有興趣 interesting 形容事物；interested 形容人的感受。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The lecture was interesting. The students were interested in the topic.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞與形容詞不同 interest 是名詞或動詞；interested 是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She has an interest in design. She is interested in design.
